purpose: A capability inventory for the useful ISO 32000-1 (PDF 1.7) and ISO 32000-2 (PDF 2.0) surface, plus PDFE product capabilities that govern safe use of that surface.
authority: This becomes authoritative only after legacy consumers are migrated and the validator is wired into CI. Until then, legacy matrices remain the current conformance authority.

sources.title: ISO 32000-1:2008, Document management — Portable document format — Part 1: PDF 1.7
ISO 32000-2:2020 with errata/corrigenda, Document management — Portable document format — Part 2: PDF 2.0
PDF Association implementation guidance and test suites
PDFE product capability and safety policy

citationAudit: Each ISO-derived capability cites source and clause; scripts/build-pdf-spec-inventory.py verifies the cited heading against the two SHA-256-pinned source PDFs without using an LLM to bulk-read the standards.
arlingtonPolicy: Use the pinned Arlington revision for PDF object dictionaries, arrays, maps, table-driven data-integrity relationships, and resolved errata. It is supplementary: lexical syntax, content streams/operators, file structure/layout, xref/incremental updates, and linearization remain governed by separately pinned ISO-derived sources and legacy operator evidence.

modeDefinitions.parse: Recognize, validate, and expose a feature without executing it.
modeDefinitions.preserve: Open-save retains it or deliberately applies the recorded conservation policy.
modeDefinitions.render: Produce the specified page appearance under the registered oracle contract.
modeDefinitions.extract: Expose relevant text, geometry, semantics, or metadata to callers.
modeDefinitions.mutate: Safely change an existing instance while conserving unrelated content.
modeDefinitions.write: Serialize a valid instance created by a core workflow.
modeDefinitions.author: Offer intentional user/API creation tooling.
modeDefinitions.execute: Perform an embedded action; security-sensitive actions must be explicit.
